name: check_consistency
description: Deterministic validation of the fields extracted so far for one declaration line (e.g. quantity must be positive, emission factors must be in a plausible range for the sector, required fields must be present). Returns a list of issues found, empty if none. Never modifies data - a validation check only.

extracted_data.description: The fields extracted so far for this declaration line, keyed by field name (e.g. quantity_tonnes, direct_emissions_actual).
